audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven phases[N].side read Skill while content win[0..6] read Aurora at Level 1, Katarina from Level 2 to first item, and Aurora at 2+ items. phases[0].why and phases[6].why both described Katarina winning rows the content layer gives to Aurora.
audit.why: packet.levelChart matches the content layer exactly. Pre-Shunpo Katarina cannot punish a 900-range Twofold Hex plus its recast, and late her Q uptime, W resets off spirit procs and Between Worlds zoning beat reset-dependent fighting — which is what whys[0], whys[6] and spikes[3] already say.
audit.corrected: Sides aligned to the content layer and packet; phases[0].why and phases[6].why rewritten in the same proposal so each row's sentence matches its new verdict.

audit.why: Level 3 is the flip (Shunpo punishes every Q cast), level 6 is Katarina's duel spike, first item is her hardest window, and 2+ items is Aurora's. Across the Veil is 22/21/20/19/18s, so the post-hop window really is the all-in timer.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit in it and named no ability cooldown at all. Nothing stated that Across the Veil turns her invisible on landing, which is why a Shunpo spent on the engage leaves you with no way to follow.
audit.why: Riot's W text: she leaps, enters the spirit realm on landing, becomes invisible and gains move speed. Cooldowns: W 22s, Q 9s, E 15s, R 140s at rank 1. Katarina's R is flagged interruptible, so any hard CC ends the channel.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field now carries W 22s, Q 9s, E 15s and R 140s with the all-in timing; dosFull[2].d and tradeBad state the invisibility on landing; dontsFull[2].d states the channel rule.

UNVERIFIED: the missing-interactions feed claims Between Worlds can cancel Death Lotus, and content late claims the arena 'teleport[s] you back into her team when you try to exit'. Riot's R text only says the shockwave damages and slows, and that the area 'allows Aurora to teleport from one side to the other' — it says nothing about displacing enemies or about a hard-CC component, even though the derived kit flag says hardCC. Per the brief I trusted the description over the flag: I left both existing strings alone and wrote my own cooldowns line without the cancel claim. Worth a human ruling before anyone asserts it.
